messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — fintech prospect wants BYO-HSM POC. Questions: will key rotation cause short downtime? they need multi-AZ failover and attested HSM.
matt_se: short answers: rotation can be zero-downtime with key versioning if app supports it, else small window during rewrap.
alex_sec: we need to confirm their requirement: do they require in-HSM rewrap or are wrapped KEKs acceptable? Also ask for SOC2 + HSM attestation doc.
jordan_sre: infra notes: Multi-AZ supported — we replicate HSM keys via KMIP-enabled wrap; failover is automated but sessions may need reconnect. We should test session limits in POC.
matt_se: pricing Q from customer: hourly HSM consumption + per-key ops. Sara, can you confirm ballpark? :thinking: 
sara_sales: Customer asked for estimate for 2-week POC w/ 3 HSM units in prodlike config — what's our standard quote?
jordan_sre: For Dedicated BYO-HSM POC we typically quote a flat POC fee + HSM attach hourly. Rough: $Xk flat + ~$Y/hr per HSM — I'll pull exact numbers.
matt_se: Also they want rotation window: rotate monthly, need to ensure all active token caches are invalidated gracefully. Recommend staggered roll with versioned keys.
alex_sec: From security: require key export policy = no plaintext export. We'll sign an ATO checklist and provide HSM attestation (FIPS + CA attestation). Also need KMS API mapping for their audit team.
sara_sales: they asked if we support offline key ceremony / manual import — yes? any ops steps to share.
jordan_sre: we support manual key import via encrypted key blobs. For POC include runbook snippet:
```
# manual import
redwood-cli kms import --blob /tmp/kek.blob --meta '{"env":"poc"}'
```
matt_se: next steps: sara to confirm POC scope + desired SLAs, alex to attach attestation, jordan to produce runbook + HSM pricing line item. deploy-bot: created POC ticket #POC-4321 :white_check_mark: 
sara_sales: will follow up with customer this afternoon and post back with required SLA/expected throughput. Thanks all :thumbsup:
